invoicing_rules.cadence: Weekly, Monday to Sunday. One invoice per week.
invoicing_rules.no_per_job_breakdown: Hours are not tracked per individual job/task — just a single running total per week for the company.
invoicing_rules.skip_empty_weeks: If no hours are logged for a given week, no invoice is generated for it.
invoicing_rules.trigger: Generate the week's invoice once all hours through that week's Sunday are logged.
invoicing_rules.auto_book_revenue: On invoice creation, immediately record the invoice amount as income (KMM pays out daily in cash — invoices are a formality). Standing rule set 2026-09-07.
